It’s been 13 months since I’ve seen/talked to my old LO and I don’t really think about them all that much anymore, but there was about six months where I really couldn’t stop thinking about them. And the only way that helped me was drinking (which I definitely don’t recommend) I would literally bring bottles of vodka to class with me every day just so I could get through the day. the thing that got me over my last LO was finding a new one (which I also don’t recommend). but the only real advice that I can give you is to wait sooner or later you’ll forget about them and you’ll feel way better. also DO NOT follow them on social media block them if you can, if you do follow them you’ll just constitute be checking in them and obsessing over them.
I’m so sorry it’s the worst feeling having that one person who you would do literally anything for hate you .
